title.en: The Relationship Between Parents and Children

title.ar: الدَّرْسُ الأَوَّل: العَلاقَةُ بَينَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناء
title.en: Lesson 1: The relationship between parents and children (reading)
title.ur: Sabaq 1: Walidain aur aulad ka rishta (parhna)

intro.en: In this reading the Quran sets the limits of the relationship between parents and children. We meet Luqman advising his son, Ibrahim and Ismail, and Nuh and his son.
intro.ur: Is parhne ke sabaq mein Quran walidain aur aulad ke rishte ki hudood batata hai. Hum Luqman ka apne bete ko nasihat karna, Ibrahim aur Ismail, aur Nuh aur unke bete ka zikr parhenge.
intro.ar: في هذِهِ القِراءَةِ يَرْسُمُ القُرْآنُ حُدودَ العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ. نَتَعَرَّفُ نُصْحَ لُقْمانَ لِابْنِهِ، وَإِبْراهيمَ وَإِسْماعيلَ، وَنُوحاً وَابْنَهُ.

dialogue.ar: الـعَلاقَةُ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ قَضِيَّةٌ شَغَلَتِ النَّاسَ جَميعَهُم، في كُلِّ زَمانٍ وَمَكان.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿalāqatu bayna l-ābāʾi wal-abnāʾi qaḍiyyatun shaghalati n-nāsa jamīʿahum, fī kulli zamānin wa makān
dialogue.en: The relationship between parents and children is an issue that has occupied all people, in every time and place.
dialogue.ur: Walidain aur aulad ka rishta aisa mas'ala hai jis ne har zamane aur har jagah sab logon ko masroof rakha.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ القُرْآنَ الكَريمَ حَدَّدَ بِجَلاءٍ الأُسُسَ السَّلِيمَةَ الَّتي تَحْكُمُ هَذِهِ العَلاقَة.
dialogue.tr: lākinna l-qurʾāna l-karīma ḥaddada bi-jalāʾin al-ususa s-salīmata llatī taḥkumu hādhihi l-ʿalāqa
dialogue.en: But the Noble Quran clearly set the sound foundations that govern this relationship.
dialogue.ur: Lekin Quran-e-Kareem ne saaf taur par woh durust bunyaadein muqarrar kar di hain jo is rishte ko chalati hain.

dialogue.ar: هَذا لُقْمانُ الحَكيمُ، يُضْرَبُ بِهِ المَثَلُ الأَعْلى لِكُلِّ أَبٍ يُدْرِكُ حَقَّ الابْنِ عَلى أَبيهِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā Luqmānu l-ḥakīm, yuḍrabu bihi l-mathalu l-aʿlā li-kulli abin yudriku ḥaqqa l-ibni ʿalā abīhi
dialogue.en: This is Luqman the Wise, the highest example for every father who understands the child's right over his father.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Luqman Hakeem hain, har us baap ke liye behtareen misaal jo bete ka haq samajhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ أَوَّلَ ما زَوَّدَهُ بِهِ العَقيدَةُ الصَّحيحَةُ الخالِصَةُ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ، فَالشِّرْكُ ظُلْمٌ عَظيم.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna awwala mā zawwadahu bihi l-ʿaqīdatu ṣ-ṣaḥīḥatu l-khāliṣatu mina sh-shirk, fa-sh-shirku ẓulmun ʿaẓīm
dialogue.en: The first thing he gave his son was a correct belief free from shirk, for shirk is a great wrong.
dialogue.ur: Sab se pehle usne bete ko shirk se paak durust aqeeda diya, kyunke shirk bohat bada zulm hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحُثُّ لُقْمانُ ابْنَهُ عَلى مُراقَبَةِ اللهِ في أَقْوالِهِ وَأَعْمالِهِ، صَغيرِها قَبْلَ كَبيرِها.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḥuthth Luqmānu ibnahu ʿalā murāqabati llāhi fī aqwālihi wa aʿmālih, ṣaghīrihā qabla kabīrihā
dialogue.en: Luqman urges his son to be mindful of Allah in his words and deeds, the small before the big.
dialogue.ur: Luqman apne bete ko apni baaton aur kaamon mein Allah ko nigraan jaanne ki taakeed karte hain, chhote bhi aur bade bhi.

dialogue.ar: وَيُنادي ابْنَهُ بِعَطْفٍ آمِراً إِيّاهُ بِأَداءِ الصَّلاةِ بِإِخْلاص.
dialogue.tr: wa yunādī ibnahu bi-ʿaṭfin āmiran iyyāhu bi-adāʾi ṣ-ṣalāti bi-ikhlāṣ
dialogue.en: He calls his son tenderly, telling him to pray sincerely.
dialogue.ur: Woh pyaar se bete ko pukarte hain aur use ikhlas ke saath namaz parhne ka hukm dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَأْمُرُهُ بِالمَعْروفِ وَيَنْهاهُ عَنِ المُنْكَرِ، وَيَصْبِرُ عَلى ما يُصيبُهُ في سَبيلِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaʾmuruhu bil-maʿrūfi wa yanhāhu ʿani l-munkar, wa yaṣbiru ʿalā mā yuṣībuhu fī sabīli llāh
dialogue.en: He tells him to enjoin good, forbid evil, and be patient with what befalls him in the way of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Woh use nek kaam ka hukm aur bure kaam se rokne ko kehte hain, aur Allah ki raah mein jo takleef aaye us par sabr karne ko.

dialogue.ar: وَيُرْشِدُهُ إِلى التَّواضُعِ لِلنَّاسِ، وَالاعْتِدالِ في مَشْيَتِهِ، وَخَفْضِ صَوْتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yurshiduhu ilā t-tawāḍuʿi lin-nās, wal-iʿtidāli fī mashyatih, wa khafḍi ṣawtih
dialogue.en: He guides him to humility with people, moderation in his walk, and lowering his voice.
dialogue.ur: Woh use logon ke saamne aajzi, chaal mein etidaal aur awaaz dheemi rakhne ki raah dikhate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا كانَ الأَبُ لُقْمانُ الحَكيمُ قَدْ ضَرَبَ مَثَلاً أَعْلى في الأُبُوَّةِ، فَإِنَّ إِسْماعيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَدْ ضَرَبَ مَثَلاً أَعْلى في البُنُوَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā kāna l-abu Luqmānu l-ḥakīmu qad ḍaraba mathalan aʿlā fī l-ubuwwa, fa-inna Ismāʿīla ʿalayhi s-salāmu qad ḍaraba mathalan aʿlā fī l-bunuwwa
dialogue.en: If Luqman the Wise gave a high example in fatherhood, Ismail, peace be upon him, gave a high example in sonhood.
dialogue.ur: Agar Luqman Hakeem ne baap hone ki behtareen misaal qaim ki, to Ismail alaihis salam ne bete hone ki behtareen misaal qaim ki.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ كانَ إِسْماعيلُ ابْناً صالِحاً بَارّاً بِأَبيهِ إِبْراهيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلام.
dialogue.tr: laqad kāna Ismāʿīlu ibnan ṣāliḥan bārran bi-abīhi Ibrāhīma ʿalayhi s-salām
dialogue.en: Ismail was a righteous son, dutiful to his father Ibrahim, peace be upon him.
dialogue.ur: Ismail ek nek bete the, apne walid Ibrahim alaihis salam ke farmanbardar.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا بَيَّنَ القُرْآنُ الكَريمُ قَضِيَّةَ العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ، فَجَعَلَ لِكُلٍّ حَقَّهُ وَحَدَّدَ واجِبَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā bayyana l-qurʾānu l-karīmu qaḍiyyata l-ʿalāqati bayna l-ābāʾi wal-abnāʾ, fa-jaʿala li-kullin ḥaqqahu wa ḥaddada wājibah
dialogue.en: In this way the Noble Quran explained the relationship between parents and children, giving each their right and fixing their duty.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah Quran-e-Kareem ne walidain aur aulad ke rishte ko wazeh kiya, har ek ka haq rakha aur uska farz muqarrar kiya.

q.en: Who is called the wise father who advised his son?
q.ur: Kis ko Hakeem baap kaha gaya jisne bete ko nasihat ki?
q.ar: مَنِ الأَبُ الحَكيمُ الَّذي نَصَحَ ابْنَهُ؟

q.en: What was the first thing Luqman gave his son?
q.ur: Luqman ne bete ko sab se pehle kya diya?
q.ar: ما أَوَّلُ ما قَدَّمَهُ لُقْمانُ لِابْنِهِ؟

q.en: Who gave a high example in sonhood (البُنُوَّة)?
q.ur: Beta hone ki behtareen misaal kis ne di?
q.ar: مَنْ ضَرَبَ مَثَلاً عالِياً في البُنُوَّةِ؟

intro.en: Here we practise the reading: match words, find meanings and answer short questions about the story of Luqman, Ibrahim, Ismail and Nuh.
intro.ur: Yahan hum matan ki mashq karte hain: lafzon ko milana, matlab dhoondhna aur Luqman, Ibrahim, Ismail aur Nuh ke qisse par chhote sawalon ke jawab dena.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى النَّصِّ: نُطابِقُ الكَلِماتِ، وَنَجِدُ المَعاني، وَنُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ حَوْلَ قِصَّةِ لُقْمانَ وَإِبْراهيمَ وَإِسْماعيلَ وَنُوحٍ.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ حَدَّدَ القُرْآنُ العَلاقَةَ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa ḥaddada l-qurʾānu l-ʿalāqata bayna l-ābāʾi wal-abnāʾ?
dialogue.en: How did the Quran define the relationship between parents and children?
dialogue.ur: Quran ne walidain aur aulad ke rishte ko kaise muqarrar kiya?

dialogue.ar: لِماذا كانَ الشِّرْكُ بِاللهِ ظُلْماً عَظيماً؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā kāna sh-shirku billāhi ẓulman ʿaẓīmā?
dialogue.en: Why is shirk with Allah a great wrong?
dialogue.ur: Allah ke saath shirk bada zulm kyun hai?

dialogue.ar: مَنِ الَّذي ضُرِبَ لَنا مَثَلاً أَعْلى في الأُبُوَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: manillādhī ḍuriba lanā mathalan aʿlā fī l-ubuwwa?
dialogue.en: Who was given to us as the highest example in fatherhood?
dialogue.ur: Baap hone ki behtareen misaal ke taur par kis ka zikr hua?

dialogue.en: Why did Nuh disown his son?
dialogue.ur: Nuh alaihis salam ne apne bete se bari hone ka izhar kyun kiya?

vocab.en: to disown, to declare oneself free of

q.en: What does the Quran say people should cooperate on?
q.ur: Quran ke mutabiq log kis par aapas mein madad karen?
q.ar: عَلى ماذا يَأْمُرُنا القُرْآنُ أَنْ نَتَعاوَنَ؟

title.en: Lesson 3: Grammar (a): The nun of protection (نون الوقاية)

intro.en: When a verb or a word like إِنَّ, لَيْتَ, لَعَلَّ is followed by 'me' (ي), a protective ن comes in between: يُطْعِمُني (he feeds me), إِنَّني (indeed I). It protects the end of the verb from a kasra. Example: أَخي يُحِبُّ المَوْزَ، وَلَكِنَّني لا أُحِبُّهُ.
intro.ur: Jab kisi fail ya إِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ ke baad 'mujhe/mera' (ي) aaye to beech mein ek ن aata hai jise Noon-ul-Wiqaya kehte hain: يُطْعِمُني (woh mujhe khilata hai), إِنَّني (beshak main). Yeh fail ke aakhir ko kasra se bachata hai. Misaal: أَخي يُحِبُّ المَوْزَ، وَلَكِنَّني لا أُحِبُّهُ (mera bhai kela pasand karta hai, lekin main nahin).
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ ياءُ المُتَكَلِّمِ بَعْدَ فِعْلٍ أَوْ بَعْدَ «إِنَّ» وَ«لَيْتَ» وَ«لَعَلَّ» تَدْخُلُ نونٌ تَحْمي آخِرَها مِنَ الكَسْرِ، وَتُسَمّى نُونَ الوِقايَةِ، مِثْلُ: يُطْعِمُني، إِنَّني. وَمِثالٌ: أَخي يُحِبُّ المَوْزَ، وَلكِنَّني لا أُحِبُّهُ.

dialogue.en: The One who created me, so He guides me.
dialogue.ur: Jis ne mujhe paida kiya, wohi mujhe hidayat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّني أَنَا اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْني
dialogue.tr: innanī anā llāhu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ʿbudnī
dialogue.en: Indeed I am Allah, there is no god but Me, so worship Me.
dialogue.ur: Beshak main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi mabood nahin, pas meri ibadat karo.

dialogue.en: Perhaps I may reach the ways.
dialogue.ur: Shayad main raaste (asbaab) tak pahunch jaaun.

dialogue.en: I saw as if I were in a strong coat of armour.
dialogue.ur: Maine dekha goya main ek mazboot zirah mein hoon.

dialogue.ar: أَخي يُحِبُّ المَوْزَ، وَلَكِنَّني لا أُحِبُّهُ
dialogue.tr: akhī yuḥibbu l-mawza, wa lākinnanī lā uḥibbuh
dialogue.en: My brother likes bananas, but I do not like them.
dialogue.ur: Mera bhai kela pasand karta hai, lekin main nahin karta.

q.en: What is the job of the nun of protection?

options: It protects the verb's ending before ي (me)
options_ar: حِمايَةُ آخِرِ الفِعْلِ قَبْلَ ياءِ المُتَكَلِّمِ

q.ur: 'Beshak main' ke liye durust lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كِتابَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِـ «إِنَّ» مَعَ ياءِ المُتَكَلِّمِ؟

title.en: Lesson 4: Listening: The family and children's friends
title.ur: Sabaq 4: Sun kar samajhna: Khandaan aur bachon ke dost

intro.en: Listen and answer: why parents think about their children's friends, and what a family does when a friend is a bad influence. Friends affect each other, so families care about them.
intro.ur: Suno aur jawab do: walidain bachon ke doston ke baare mein kyun sochte hain, aur agar dost bura ho to khandaan kya karta hai. Dost ek doosre par asar daalte hain, isliye ghar wale unki fikr karte hain.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ وَنُجيبُ: لِماذا يَهْتَمُّ الوالِدانِ بِأَصْدِقاءِ أَبْنائِهِما؟ وَماذا تَفْعَلُ الأُسْرَةُ إِذا كانَ الصَّديقُ سَيِّئَ التَّأْثيرِ؟ فَالأَصْدِقاءُ يُؤَثِّرونَ في بَعْضِهِمْ.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يُفَكِّرُ الآباءُ في أَصْدِقاءِ أَوْلادِهِم؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā yufakkiru l-ābāʾu fī aṣdiqāʾi awlādihim?
dialogue.en: Why do parents think about their children's friends?
dialogue.ur: Walidain bachon ke doston ke baare mein kyun sochte hain?

dialogue.en: Because a friend is influenced by his friend.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke dost apne dost se asar leta hai.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَدْعو الأُسْرَةُ أَصْدِقاءَ الأَوْلادِ إِلى البَيْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā tadʿū l-usratu aṣdiqāʾa l-awlādi ilā l-bayt?
dialogue.en: Why does the family invite the children's friends home?
dialogue.ur: Ghar wale bachon ke doston ko ghar kyun bulate hain?

dialogue.en: To get to know them.
dialogue.ur: Unse waqif hone ke liye.

q.en: Why do parents think about their children's friends?
q.ur: Walidain bachon ke doston ke baare mein kyun sochte hain?

options: Because a friend is influenced by his friend

q.en: Why does the family invite the children's friends home?
q.ur: Ghar wale doston ko ghar kyun bulate hain?
q.ar: لِماذا تَدْعو الأُسْرَةُ أَصْدِقاءَ الأَوْلادِ إِلى البَيْتِ؟

title.en: Lesson 5: Speaking and writing: The dutiful child
title.ur: Sabaq 5: Bolna aur likhna: Farmanbardar bacha

intro.en: Ask and answer questions with a partner about treating parents well, then write a story called 'A child dutiful to his parents'.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath walidain se acha sulook karne ke baare mein sawal jawab karein, phir 'Walidain ka farmanbardar bacha' ke unwan par kahani likhein.
intro.ar: نَسْأَلُ وَنُجيبُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ الإِحْسانِ إِلى الوالِدَيْنِ، ثُمَّ نَكْتُبُ قِصَّةً بِعُنْوانِ «الوَلَدُ البارُّ بِوالِدَيْهِ».

dialogue.en: How do you treat your parents?
dialogue.ur: Aap apne walidain ke saath kaisa sulook karte hain?

dialogue.en: Why must we be kind to parents?
dialogue.ur: Walidain ke saath ehsaan kyun zaroori hai?

dialogue.ar: ما جَزاءُ مَنْ يُحْسِنُ إِلى والِدَيْهِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā jazāʾu man yuḥsinu ilā wālidayh?
dialogue.en: What is the reward of one who is kind to his parents?
dialogue.ur: Jo apne walidain ke saath ehsaan kare uska ajar kya hai?

dialogue.en: Do you follow your parents' advice? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap apne walidain ki nasihat par chalte hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: رِضا اللهِ عَنِ الوَلَدِ لِرِضا والِدَيْهِ عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: riḍā llāhi ʿani l-waladi li-riḍā wālidayhi ʿanh
dialogue.en: Allah's pleasure with a child is through his parents' pleasure with him.
dialogue.ur: Bachay se Allah ki razamandi uske walidain ki razamandi se hai.

options_ar: ما يُعْطى مُقابِلَ العَمَلِ ثَواباً أَوْ عِقاباً

q.en: According to the sentence, Allah's pleasure is linked to...
q.ur: Jumle ke mutabiq Allah ki razamandi kis se judi hai?

title.en: Lesson 6: Spelling: joining and separating مَنْ
title.ur: Sabaq 6: Imla: «مَنْ» ka milna aur alag likhna

intro.en: Rule: when a preposition comes before مَنْ, they join and the ن doubles: عَمَّنْ, مِمَّنْ, فِيمَنْ. When مَنْ comes first and the preposition after it, they stay separate: مَنْ في الفَصْلِ؟
intro.ur: Qaida: agar harf-e-jar مَنْ se pehle aaye to dono mil jate hain: عَمَّنْ، مِمَّنْ، فِيمَنْ. Agar مَنْ pehle aaye aur harf-e-jar baad mein to alag likhte hain: مَنْ في الفَصْلِ؟
intro.ar: القاعِدَةُ: إِذا سَبَقَ حَرْفُ الجَرِّ «مَنْ» اتَّصَلا وَشُدِّدَتِ النّونُ: عَمَّنْ، مِمَّنْ، فِيمَنْ. وَإِذا جاءَتْ «مَنْ» أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ حَرْفُ الجَرِّ بَقِيا مُنْفَصِلَيْنِ: مَنْ في الفَصْلِ؟

dialogue.en: Whom are you looking for?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis ko dhoondh rahe hain?

dialogue.en: Whom do you fear?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis se darte hain?

dialogue.en: In whom do you trust?
dialogue.ur: Aap kis par bharosa karte hain?

dialogue.en: Which of the students came?
dialogue.ur: Talaba mein se kaun aaya?

dialogue.en: Who is in the class among the students?
dialogue.ur: Jamaat mein talaba mein se kaun hai?

q.en: When a preposition comes before مَنْ, they...
q.ur: Harf-e-jar مَنْ se pehle aaye to...
Kaun sa milakar likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ كُتِبَتْ فيها الكَلِمَتانِ مُتَّصِلَتَيْنِ؟

q.en: When مَنْ comes first, then a preposition, they are...
q.ur: Jab مَنْ pehle ho aur harf-e-jar baad mein to...
q.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ «مَنْ» أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ حَرْفُ الجَرِّ فَإِنَّهُما...

title.en: Lesson 7: Grammar (b): Verbal nouns of three-letter verbs
title.ur: Sabaq 7: Qawaid (be): Teen harfi afaal ke masdar

intro.en: The masdar (verbal noun) means an action without time, like 'travelling'. Many three-letter masdars are learned by hearing, but some patterns are common: فَعيل for travel (رَحَلَ: رَحيلاً), فُعال for illness (سَعَلَ: سُعالاً), فِعالَة for a craft (زَرَعَ: زِراعَة), فُعْلَة for colour (حَمُرَ: حُمْرَة), فَعَلان for agitation (غَلى: غَلَياناً).
intro.ur: Masdar wo lafz hai jo bina zamane ke kaam ka matlab de, jaise 'safar karna'. Bohat se teen harfi masdar sun kar yaad hote hain, lekin kuch wazan aam hain: فَعيل safar ke liye (رَحَلَ: رَحيلاً)، فُعال bimari ke liye (سَعَلَ: سُعالاً)، فِعالَة pesha ke liye (زَرَعَ: زِراعَة)، فُعْلَة rang ke liye (حَمُرَ: حُمْرَة)، فَعَلان bechaini ke liye (غَلى: غَلَياناً).
intro.ar: المَصْدَرُ اسْمٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى الحَدَثِ مِنْ غَيْرِ زَمَنٍ، مِثْلُ «السَّفَرِ». وَأَكْثَرُ مَصادِرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ سَماعِيَّةٌ، وَمِنْها أَوْزانٌ شائِعَةٌ: فَعيل لِلسَّفَرِ (رَحَلَ: رَحيلاً)، وَفُعال لِلمَرَضِ (سَعَلَ: سُعالاً)، وَفِعالَة لِلحِرْفَةِ (زَرَعَ: زِراعَة)، وَفُعْلَة لِلَّوْنِ (حَمُرَ: حُمْرَة)، وَفَعَلان لِلِاضْطِرابِ (غَلى: غَلَياناً).
